verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe launching a Local browser (`localBrowser.launch`) or attaching over CDP to a Chromium instance you're already running, as alternatives to Browserbase cloud sessions, and the quickstart shows getting from an empty directory to a working automation without mention of requiring a cloud account. This directly supports running against a local browser for development. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of a fully offline/no-account local workflow, and no explicit statement that no API keys/cloud accounts are ever needed for LLM inference during local runs.
